hooks.name: PBT on spec change
hooks.description: Runs the skeleton-core test suite whenever matching-spec.md or payments-dispute-spec.md is saved. Blocks further changes (exit 2) if any test fails.

action.command: cd "$(dirname "$0" | sed 's|/.kiro.*||')" 2>/dev/null || cd /home/chizihn/Desktop/Boneyard; echo "=== pbt-on-spec-change: spec file saved, running skeleton-core tests ===" >&2; if pnpm --filter @boneyard/skeleton-core test; then   echo "=== Tests passed — safe to continue ===" >&2;   exit 0; else   echo "=== BLOCKED: skeleton-core tests failed after spec change. Fix tests before continuing. ===" >&2;   exit 2; fi
